editorial:
Imagine waking up and deciding that the stars know exactly what you should do with your life. That is exactly what happens to Vincent and his buddy Antoine. These two guys decide to stop thinking for themselves and start following their daily horoscopes to the letter. They believe this is the secret key to finding money and success, but instead, they just find themselves in a series of wild and embarrassing situations. The vibe is lighthearted and silly, making it a great choice if you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some chaotic energy.

What really makes this work is the way the misunderstandings pile up. The acting is energetic, and the pacing keeps you moving along without feeling slow. While some of the jokes might feel a bit dated since it is from the seventies, the core idea of blindly following a newspaper is still funny. If you are into old-school comedies, you should definitely check this out. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or if you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with the duo realizing that the stars are not actually guiding them to a pot of gold. After a long chain of accidents and weird coincidences, they find that following the horoscope blindly only led to chaos. In the end, they learn that taking control of their own lives is much better than trusting a random printout. They stop the madness and decide to find their own luck instead of relying on the zodiac.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old French comedies and stories about bad luck.
